candidate_evidence.quote: The experimental intervention includes a strict and controlled diet that manages daily macronutrient breakdown and increases the ratio of dietary fat relative to protein and carbohydrate consumption.

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Newly diagnosed glioblastoma (Within 2 months of initial diagnosis by histopathology)
